strategies.name: liquidity_grab_reversal
strategies.entry_summary: Identify a liquidity grab where price briefly breaks support or resistance and then reverses. Enter at the candle that made the liquidity grab: for longs at the top of the grab candle after a sell-side grab, and for shorts at the bottom of the grab candle after a buy-side grab.
strategies.exit_summary: Place the stop loss just beyond the liquidity grab and take profit at a recent swing level in the opposite direction: a recent high for longs or a recent low for shorts.

variants.timeframe_note: Works on all timeframes; examples include daily context and 15-minute entries
variants.confirmation_mechanic_note: Manual identification of the liquidity grab candle and entry level
variants.target_note: Take profit at a recent high/low

variants.confirmation_mechanic_note: Use the indicator's marked liquidity grab and entry signal instead of manually spotting it

variants.timeframe_note: Example given: 15-minute entry aligned with 1-hour support/resistance
variants.confirmation_mechanic_note: Only take the base liquidity-grab reversal when it occurs at the top or bottom of a higher-timeframe range/support/resis

canonical.enumeration_note: The video teaches one runnable reversal strategy: a liquidity-grab reversal with fixed stop beyond the grab and target at recent swing highs/lows. Divergence, higher-timeframe top/bottom filtering, indicator use, and the 10-candle preference are presented as confluences/variants, not separate entry-exit skeletons.
